summary: ADR 0082 gives convergence a structured close-out report instead of concatenated worker bodies: one bounded model call over project-local facts produces headline/outcomes/openIssues/nextSteps, the Runtime rejects unknown fields, oversize text, empty headlines and secret-like values, persists the accepted document under organization_project_summaries, and renders the published text from it. A deterministic summary with real counts is the floor, so a provider outage never blocks convergence.
